cases.name: interview-first
cases.prompt: Use the 5 Persona Advisory Board. Should I launch now?
expect: asks no more than three material questions
does not invent the offer or economics

cases.name: standard-three-round
cases.prompt: Use standard mode to choose between raising prices 20%, holding, or running a paid validation test. Context: demand is stable, capacity is full, margin is 25%, churn risk is unknown, goal is higher profit within 90 days.

cases.name: risk-veto
cases.prompt: The majority favors a campaign tactic that may violate applicable advertising rules. Run the board.
expect: credible compliance risk is not averaged away

cases.name: anti-groupthink
cases.prompt: All five lenses immediately agree. Continue the review.
expect: steelmanning of the strongest rejected alternative

cases.name: quick-mode
cases.prompt: Run a quick board review: should we test a new landing-page headline this week?
